findings.evidence: Lines 186 and 224 both need `erw [quotientSheafι_app_apply]`; plain `rw`/`simp` would suffice if the LHS matched syntactically.
findings.fix: State the lemma in the form produced in context, e.g. `(quotientSheafι I s).hom.app (op U) f = …`, with the codomain left to elaboration or via `ConcreteCategory.hom`, and check it fires with `simp`/`rw`.

findings.fix: Use `rw`/`simp only` on those germ lemmas, after the `change` step or by stating the goal via `ConcreteCategory.comp_apply`; otherwise add a comment saying why `erw` is needed.
findings.issue: `erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]` and `erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward_germ_apply]` (line 223) in `quotientStalkBranch_germ` depend on undocumented defeq matching through the `CommRingCat` hom and `eqToHom` wrappers.

findings.evidence: Line 233 needs `erw` immediately after the `rfl`-destructuring `obtain` produces the `germ` form the lemma is supposed to match.
findings.fix: Restate `quotientStalkBranch_germ` (e.g. with membership proof `hx ▸ hz` and an LHS that matches syntactically) so that `rw`/`simp` applies here.
findings.issue: `erw [quotientStalkBranch_germ, quotientStalkBranch_germ]`: the new `@[simp]` lemma cannot be used with `rw` on its own downstream goal, so it is not in usable simp-normal form.

summary: Six undocumented `erw` rewrites depend on definitional unfolding; the root cause is that the simp lemma `quotientSheafι_app_apply` is stated with an explicit codomain that other proofs never produce, so it cannot fire under `rw`/`simp`.
